scientific_integrity: The originating chain model, current formulas and rank-one long-time scaled cumulants are prior results. The claim is the exact finite-time heat coboundary, its calibrated Gamma-difference limit and the calibrated network reversibility classification. No independent scientific audit has been performed.
scientific_limitations: Only finite underdamped harmonic networks with positive bidirectional edge couplings are treated.
Gauge sufficiency assumes symmetric positive-definite weighted stiffness; all-bath necessity assumes positive friction at all vertices and a smooth positive stationary density.
The Gamma-difference result requires a calibrated, initially stationary finite chain and a large-observation-time limit.
Diagonal symmetrization and cycle consistency are classical; two-site precursors may already exist.
title: A thermal gauge and exact heat coboundary for nonreciprocal harmonic networks
